recognize_zh: 骨髓切片中造血組織之間散布大量淡染、細胞質豐富的組織球，成片或單個出現（箭頭所指），細胞質呈淡粉灰色、略帶纖維感，取代部分骨髓空間，符合 Gaucher 細胞浸潤。
features: Numerous large histiocytes with abundant pale, lightly eosinophilic-grey cytoplasm scattered singly and in clusters (arrows)
Histiocytes have small, round, eccentric nuclei and faintly fibrillary cytoplasm
Interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate displacing hematopoietic elements
Residual trilineage hematopoiesis between the histiocytes
Bony trabeculae without evident osteolysis at this magnification
describe_en: Bone marrow core biopsy shows hypercellular marrow with bony trabeculae and an interstitial and focally sheet-like infiltrate of large pale histiocytes (arrows). The histiocytes contain abundant pale, faintly fibrillary cytoplasm and small eccentric nuclei, and they displace the residual trilineage hematopoiesis. No atypical lymphoid infiltrate or granulomas are seen at this magnification. Findings are consistent with marrow involvement by Gaucher cells in the setting of Gaucher disease.

ddx.vs: These look similar on H&E, so they are separated by the accompanying neoplastic population (myeloid hyperplasia or plasma cells) and normal glucocerebrosidase activity.
Niemann-Pick foam cells have bubbly, vacuolated cytoplasm rather than the finely fibrillary cytoplasm of Gaucher cells.

ddx.dx: Mycobacterial infection (e.g. MAI in immunocompromised hosts)
ddx.vs: Mycobacteria-laden histiocytes can mimic Gaucher cells but contain acid-fast bacilli on Ziehl-Neelsen stain.

ddx.dx: Metastatic signet-ring or clear cell carcinoma
ddx.vs: Carcinoma cells form cohesive clusters with atypical nuclei and are cytokeratin-positive, whereas Gaucher cells are bland and CD68/CD163-positive.
